copy.tagline: 在不同抽象层次间进行联想与创意组合
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同抽象层次间进行创意联想与内容生成
copy.tagline_en: Bisociate ideas across multiple abstraction levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate creative connections across different levels of abstraction

howto.what: 当您提供一个概念后，Claude 会把它分解成具体、功能、结构和抽象四个层次，并在每一层探索与其他概念碰撞出新想法的机会。
howto.when: 当您给出一个概念并要求进行多级联觉或抽象阶梯分析时触发。

say.text: 请对“智能手机”进行抽象阶梯分析。
say.note: Claude 将分解智能手机并寻找创新点。

say.text: 分析“共享经济”的多级联觉。
say.note: Claude 会从四个层次展开跨界组合。

howto.what_en: When you provide a concept, Claude will decompose it into concrete, functional, structural, and abstract levels, and at each level identify collision opportunities with other concepts to generate novel ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a concept and ask for multi-level bisociation or abstraction ladder analysis.

say_en.text: Please perform abstraction ladder analysis on 'smartphone'.
say_en.note: Claude will decompose smartphone and look for innovation opportunities.
Claude will explore cross-domain combinations at all four levels.
